lessons.title: Strategy for implementation
lessons.vector_text: code_compute. implementation. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Define interface, invariants, error behavior and acceptance tests before implementation; build the smallest correct path, then cover boundaries.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Verify valid, boundary and invalid inputs against the stated contract.

lessons.title: Strategy for debugging
lessons.vector_text: code_compute. debugging. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Reproduce deterministically, minimize the failing case, isolate the violated assumption, patch the smallest cause, then add regression coverage.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Show the regression fails before the patch and passes after it.

lessons.title: Strategy for algorithm
lessons.vector_text: code_compute. algorithm. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Define computational model, input scale, invariant, termination and complexity; compare alternatives under the real constraint set.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Use adversarial inputs and verify correctness invariant plus complexity bound.

lessons.title: Strategy for testing
lessons.vector_text: code_compute. testing. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Map requirements to observable assertions; combine boundary, negative, property and regression tests; record uncovered behavior.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Inject representative faults and confirm the suite detects them.

lessons.title: Strategy for performance
lessons.vector_text: code_compute. performance. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Measure a reproducible baseline, profile the dominant bottleneck, change one factor, rerun equivalent workload and quantify tradeoffs.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Compare repeated before/after measurements including variance and resource cost.

lessons.vector_text: physics_engineering. derivation. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: State physical assumptions, coordinate/sign conventions and governing laws; derive symbolically, check units and limiting cases before numerical substitution.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Check dimensions and recover known limiting regimes.

lessons.title: Strategy for dimensioning
lessons.vector_text: physics_engineering. dimensioning. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Define loads, duty cycle, safety factors, materials and environmental bounds; size from worst credible cases and identify governing constraint.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Recalculate at min/max loads and credible degraded conditions.

lessons.title: Strategy for simulation
lessons.vector_text: physics_engineering. simulation. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Define model equations, boundary/initial conditions, solver tolerances and validation target; distinguish numerical convergence from physical validation.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Perform mesh/time-step or tolerance convergence and compare with an independent reference.

lessons.title: Strategy for feasibility
lessons.vector_text: physics_engineering. feasibility. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Close mass, energy, power, thermal, structural and operational budgets at consistent assumptions; compare margins with component limits.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Stress dominant assumptions and identify which constraint fails first.

lessons.title: Strategy for failure analysis
lessons.vector_text: physics_engineering. failure_analysis. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Enumerate failure modes, triggers, propagation, detectability and recovery; rank by consequence and evidence rather than intuition.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Inject each critical failure and verify containment, detection or safe-state behavior.
